column3: Retains the two commands go and go up, and the oath to the patriarchs.
Retains the ethnic collective singulars where BSB uses plural people names.
Retains the movement up into your midst and the act of knowing what to do.
Does not insert the LORD as the expressed subject of speak.
Retains My face will go, without adding with you.
Retains the repeated I and Your people and the declarative we will be distinguished.
Retains the passive My face will not be seen.
